segments.title: Paste this before any gift
segments.say: Before you buy any gift this year, paste this.

segments.title: 46% will ask AI first
segments.say: In a new survey, forty six percent of US shoppers plan to use AI to compare prices.
I'm buying this. Give me three cheaper options, and what to check before I buy.
segments.text: I'm buying [item]. 3 cheaper options? What should I check?

segments.title: Then check the store
segments.say: Then check the real price on the store page. AI prices can be out of date.
segments.text: Cheaper options: … Check first: return policy, shipping, warranty…

segments.title: Always check yourself
segments.say: Today's price, the return policy, and shipping. Every time.
Save this for Black Friday, and follow for one prompt a day.
